# pychum

> Pure-Python input file generator for computational chemistry workflows (ORCA and eOn). TOML in, validated dataclasses, rendered engine input out.

Docs: https://pychum.rgoswami.me/
Repo: https://github.com/HaoZeke/pychum
PyPI / conda-forge: pychum
Context7: /haozeke/pychum

Use `pychum.engine.orca` and `pychum.engine.eon`. Do not import private `_` modules.

## Docs

- [Tutorial](https://pychum.rgoswami.me/tutorial.html)
- [Install](https://pychum.rgoswami.me/howto/install.html)
- [FAQ](https://pychum.rgoswami.me/howto/faq.html)
- [ORCA blocks](https://pychum.rgoswami.me/dev/orca_blocks.html)
- [Template system](https://pychum.rgoswami.me/dev/template_system.html)

## Siblings

- [rgpycrumbs](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/): CLI, surfaces, viz dispatch
- [chemparseplot](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/): parse and plot chemistry outputs

## Install

```sh
uv add pychum
# or
pip install pychum
```
